title: Behavior Tree
description: A behavior tree definition for Minecraft Bedrock Edition. Behavior trees define complex entity AI behaviors using a tree structure of nodes. This is an experimental/internal format.

minecraft:behavior_tree.title: Behavior Tree Definition
minecraft:behavior_tree.description:
The behavior tree definition container.

Properties:
• minecraft:name (string)
• minecraft:root ({ minecraft:sequence, minecraft:selector, minecraft:attack, ... })

minecraft:name.title: Name
minecraft:name.description: The name of this behavior tree.

minecraft:root.title: Root Node
minecraft:root.description:
The root node of the behavior tree.

Properties:
• minecraft:sequence ({ children })
• minecraft:selector ({ children })
• minecraft:attack (object)
• minecraft:interact (object)
• minecraft:look_at_entity (object)

minecraft:sequence.title: Sequence
minecraft:sequence.description:
A sequence node that executes children in order until one fails.

Properties:
• children

children.title: Children
children.description: Child nodes to execute in sequence.

defaultSnippets.label: Sequence
defaultSnippets.description: A sequence node that executes children in order until one fails.

minecraft:selector.title: Selector
minecraft:selector.description:
A selector node that executes children until one succeeds.

Properties:
• children

defaultSnippets.label: Selector
defaultSnippets.description: A selector node that executes children until one succeeds.

minecraft:look_at_entity.title: Look At Entity
minecraft:look_at_entity.description: A node that makes the entity look at another entity.
